metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1033 (System Owner/User Discovery). Adversaries may attempt to identify the primary user, currently logged in user, set of users that commonly uses a system, or whether a user is actively using the system. They may do this, for example,
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1033" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-032
